notes: Keep the camera, horizon and perspective fixed.
Modules overlap by design; do not trim to the visible contour.
Lighting should stay neutral enough for the runtime shader.
Window panes must be transparent in architecture.webp so the exterior layer can change independently.

architecture-reference.prompt: Clean room plate: remove counter, stools and back-bar furniture, reconstruct hidden wall and floor, and make the two marked window panes transparent while preserving frames, mullions, curtains and reflections.

shelf-reference.prompt: Isolated back-bar cabinet matching this camera. Keep shelves empty; bottle decor is rendered separately.

counter-reference.prompt: Isolated counter with transparent surroundings and 16-24 px visual bleed around its silhouette.
